battle.name: 怛羅斯戰役
battle.brief: 天寶十載八月，安西四鎮節度使高仙芝率蕃漢兵與葛邏祿傭兵深入七百餘里，與阿拔斯軍在怛羅斯河谷相持五日；葛邏祿陣前倒戈，唐軍腹背受敵，僅不足兩千人還師。卡面羅馬弩砲早於本役八百年，未入中亞，但它「一發一具重箭」的射程邏輯，正是當日唐軍弩陣與大食配重投石機共同的底子。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 天寶十載（751）秋，本役是唐與阿拔斯兩大帝國在河中地區（錫爾河與阿姆河之間）的一次正面碰撞。唐方以安西四鎮節度使高仙芝為安西行軍總管，自龜茲、焉耆、于闐、疏勒四鎮抽調蕃漢兵，輔以拔汗那國的附庸兵與天山葛邏祿部的傭兵；副將李嗣業、段秀實與總管封常清分領各部，後方由河西節度使節制，糧餉靠安西—河西—長安的接力驛傳。大食方以呼羅珊總督奈斯爾·本·賽義爾掛名統帥，實際前線由撒馬爾罕方向的主將齊雅德·本·薩利赫指揮，前鋒由薩阿德·本·哈米德率騎隊擔任，艾布·穆斯林自呼羅珊派來援軍，並招集突騎施、朅支與倒向的葛邏祿部眾；中國方面的說法還把吐蕃部眾列入大食一軍。此外，石國（佉什）、拔汗那、碎葉等粟特城邦都在場景之內，卻分屬不同陣營：石國王子求援於大食，拔汗那出兵助唐又在中途反噬，碎葉則是唐與大食都曾經營過的舊地。
countriesEn: Fought in the autumn of 751 (Tianbao 10), this was a head-on collision between the two great empires of the day in Transoxiana, the corridor between the Syr Darya and the Amu Darya. On the Tang side, Gao Xianzhi, military commissioner of the four Anxi garrisons, drew Chinese and native troops out of Kucha, Yanqi, Khotan and Shule and added Farghana vassal contingents together with Karluk mercenaries from the Tian Shan; his deputies Li Siye and Duan Xiushi led the vanguard, Feng Changqing handled the army's administration, the rear was controlled by the Hexi commissioner, and the food and pay travelled by a relay of post stations running from Anxi through Hexi to Chang'an. On the Abbasid side, Nasr ibn Sayyar, governor of Khurasan, was the nominal commander, but the fighting line was actually directed by Ziyad ibn Salih al-Mughani of Samarkand, with Sa'd b. Hameed commanding the advance guard and reinforcements dispatched by Abu Muslim out of Khurasan; the Turgesh, the Qirghiz and the Karluks who turned to them were gathered in as well, and Chinese accounts even list Tibetan contingents in the Arab army. Around all of this stood the Sogdian city-states — Shash, Farghana, Suyab — each tied to a different side: the prince of Shash appealed to the Arabs for help, Farghana first supplied troops to the Tang and then turned on them mid-retreat, and Suyab was old ground that both the Tang and the Arabs had tried to hold.
people: 高仙芝（高句麗出身，安西四鎮節度使）是本役的關鍵人物。他在帕米爾打退吐蕃，又於龜茲得手，把唐朝的邊界推到蔥嶺以西；他的戰略是「以漢兵制蕃，以蕃兵制蕃」，用天山的突騎施與葛邏祿充當嚮導與傭兵。本役中他連下兩步險棋：先是用拔汗那兵去抄朅支（吉爾吉斯）的村落，把一支原本可以結盟的勢力推到阿拉伯人一邊；戰敗當晚他又想翌日再戰，被李嗣業力勸才下令東撤。李嗣業是安西的陌刀猛將，據唐人記載，敗退之際他主張搗毀唐軍供在怛羅斯佛寺的十一尺金身佛像，免得敵人藉神像惑眾；撤退途中他率重甲騎兵為全軍殺開血路，段秀實責其不戰先退，他回身衝陣，斬首數百級。段秀實更出名的是先前在龜茲持矛刺殺國王之事。阿拉伯方面，齊雅德·本·薩利赫據說早年曾在安西道吃過敗仗，此役是他第一次在河中正面壓倒唐軍；艾布·穆斯林在阿拔斯革命後主持東方戰線，751年五月抵達的援軍是他經營的成果；呼羅珊總督奈斯爾·本·賽義爾掛名統帥。最關鍵的第三方是葛邏祿部：他們原是唐軍傭兵，卻在第五日陣前倒戈，一擊決定全場勝負。
peopleEn: Gao Xianzhi, a Goguryeo-born Tang general and military commissioner of the four Anxi garrisons, was the pivotal figure of the campaign. He had driven the Tibetans back in the Pamirs, had taken Kucha, and pushed the Tang frontier west beyond the Congling range; his system was to use Chinese troops against the Tibetans and native troops against the natives, hiring the Turgesh and the Karluks of the Tian Shan as guides and mercenaries. In this battle he made two ruinous judgements: first he sent Farghana soldiers to raid the villages of the Qirghiz, driving a people who could have been an ally into the Arab camp; then, on the night of the defeat, he wanted to fight again the next day and was talked out of it by Li Siye. Li Siye was the fierce glaive officer of Anxi, and the Tang records have him arguing at the height of the rout that the eleven-foot gilt Buddha the army had set up in the Talas temple be smashed, so that the enemy could not use the image to sway the people; on the withdrawal he led the armoured cavalry to cut a path for the whole army, and when Duan Xiushi reproached him for retreating without a fight he turned back, charged the pursuers and cut off several hundred heads. Duan Xiushi was already famous for the Kucha affair, when he ran the king through with a spear. On the Arab side, Ziyad ibn Salih is said to have suffered a defeat on the Anxi road in earlier years, and this was the first time he openly outfought the Tang in Transoxiana; Abu Muslim, who ran the eastern front after the Abbasid revolution, sent the reinforcements that reached the field in May 751, and Nasr ibn Sayyar, governor of Khurasan, held the nominal command. The decisive third party was the Karluk confederation: hired soldiers in the Tang army, they turned their weapons on their employers on the fifth day, and that single stroke decided the whole battle.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬弩砲（Scorpio）不屬於751年——它是公元前一世紀的羅馬扭力投射機，一發一具重箭，本役現場不可能有真正的羅馬弩砲出現。它值得放在這張卡上，是因為它代表的那個原理在八世紀的中亞仍然活著：把力量先存起來，只放一箭，送到遠處。唐軍延續的正是這條線：弩以蹶張器上弦，能連續快速擊發；床弩更笨重，靠絞盤或槓桿把弦拉滿，一發一具大箭，射程遠超步弓，是本役唐軍前排壓制火力所在。卡面弩砲的另一支後裔在阿拉伯營裡：從拜占庭傳入西亞的配重式投石機，阿拔斯人稱之為「西方投石機」，把扭力砲改成了懸臂配重，拋的是石彈而非箭；阿拉伯軍中的弩手也編有相當數量。除此之外，兩軍的常備武裝是：唐軍用長槊、陌刀、步弩與大量箭鏃，披甲重騎兵配鎧甲馬，是高仙芝深入河中賴以作戰的核心；大食方以阿拉伯、波斯、中亞混合的弓騎兵為主，配標槍與彎刀，並有前鋒挖塹壕、結密集盾槍陣的習慣，攻城與野戰都備有投石機與繩梯。後勤才是唐軍真正的短板：從龜茲到怛羅斯數千里，深入七百餘里後全靠拔汗那與沿途粟特城邦徵發，馬匹與駱駝的耗損，直接決定了他們能撐多久。
kitsEn: The Roman bolt-throwing engine on this card does not belong to 751: it is a first-century BC Roman torsion machine, one heavy bolt to a shot, and no true Scorpio could possibly have stood in the Talas valley. It earns its place on the card because the principle it embodies was still alive in eighth-century Central Asia — store the power first, release a single bolt, and put it far away. The Tang carried that line forward: the crossbow was cocked with a stirrup and could be shot again and again with speed; the bed crossbow was heavier still, drawn to full tension by windlass or lever, fired one huge bolt at a time, and reached far beyond the range of an ordinary bow, and it was this that formed the Tang army's front rank of suppression fire in this campaign. The other descendant of the card's engine stood in the Arab camp: the counterweight trebuchet, brought to West Asia from Byzantium and called by the Abbasids the "western" mangonel, rewrote the torsion machine as a counterweighted throwing arm hurling stone instead of arrows; the Arab army also carried a substantial body of crossbowmen. Apart from that, the standing equipment of the two armies was as follows. The Tang used long spears, the long cutting glaive, foot crossbows and very large numbers of arrows, and their armoured heavy cavalry with armoured horses was the core on which Gao Xianzhi relied for his deep push into Transoxiana. The Arab side leaned on mixed Arab, Persian and Central Asian mounted archers with javelins and curved sabres, and their habit of letting the advance guard dig trenches and form a dense shield-and-spear line, with trebuchets and rope ladders prepared for both siege and field work. Logistics, not weapons, were the Tang army's real weakness: thousands of li from Kucha to Talas, and after driving more than seven hundred li in, everything depended on requisitions from Farghana and the Sogdian cities along the route, so the wastage of horses and camels directly decided how long they could hold on.
tactics: 打法可以由《通典》《舊唐書》《資治通鑑》與阿拉伯方面的記述互相對照。大食前鋒薩阿德·本·哈米德在怛羅斯河南岸望見唐軍，沒有退走，而是就地挖塹、結成密集的盾槍陣，硬把唐軍第一次衝鋒頂回去，等主力和援軍到齊才反推。五日之中每日皆由唐軍先攻：弩手與射手在前排齊射，據阿拉伯方面的記述，唐弩在準頭與射程上明顯佔優，把阿拉伯弓手壓得抬不起頭；步兵在後列成盾牆，箭雨越過盾縫，雙方各有騎兵趁隙衝鋒試探，一連數日不分勝負。第五日是轉捩點：葛邏祿傭兵陣前倒戈，轉而攻擊唐軍側背，阿拔斯主力同時正面壓上，唐軍腹背受敵，勉強支持到入夜才退入營寨。撤退是第二場災難：翌日清晨全軍東行翻越天山，途中的拔汗那舊盟友突然倒戈襲擊，隊伍被切成數段，李嗣業率重甲騎兵殺開一條血路，高仙芝與部分將官才得以脫身，絕大多數唐軍以及隨行的馬匹、器械被大食軍俘獲。
tacticsEn: The way the fight was fought can be reconstructed by comparing the Tongdian, the Old Book of Tang, the Comprehensive Mirror and the Islamic accounts with one another. When Sa'd b. Hameed, the Arab advance guard, sighted the Tang army on the south bank of the Talas, he did not withdraw: he dug in on the spot, closed into a dense shield-and-spear line, and absorbed the first Tang charge, holding his ground until the main body and the reinforcements had come up before counter-pushing. Every one of the five days the Tang attacked first, archers and crossbowmen in the front rank firing volleys; according to the Arabic accounts the Tang crossbows were clearly superior in both accuracy and range and kept the Arab archers pinned down. Behind them the infantry stood in a shield wall, arrows going over the top, while cavalry on both sides charged into the gaps to test the other side, and for several days neither could gain anything. The fifth day was the turning point: the Karluk mercenaries turned their weapons on the Tang flank and rear, the Abbasid main force pressed in from the front at the same moment, and the Tang army, taken in the flank and the rear, held until nightfall before falling back into its camp. The withdrawal was a second disaster. At dawn the whole army set out east and began crossing the Tian Shan, and the Ferghana allies who had fought beside them suddenly turned and attacked, cutting the column into several sections; Li Siye led the armoured cavalry through the encirclement and cut a road out, and only then did Gao Xianzhi and a few of his officers escape, while the great majority of the Tang troops, with the horses and equipment that went with them, were taken by the Arab army.
data: 兵力數字各書說法懸殊，只能照記錄列出。中國方面記唐軍「蕃漢三萬」，一般解作漢兵約一萬、葛邏祿傭兵約二萬；阿拉伯方面的記載把唐聯軍寫成十萬，明顯誇大。大食軍方面，現代西方研究估計約三萬人；中國史料卻寫成二十萬、且含吐蕃部眾，應是戰報式誇大。官方檔案記安西四鎮總兵約二萬四千，分駐龜茲、焉耆、于闐、疏勒，唐朝此番出兵不過其中一部。時間上，本役屬天寶十載八月，阿拉伯紀年為回曆133年，換算公曆在751年7至8月之間；漢文記載「深入七百餘里」抵達怛羅斯城，該城在塔拉斯河谷，與碎葉所在的楚河谷地相距不遠。傷亡方面：《通典》是最早敘述此役的文獻，稱死者三萬；《舊唐書》記二萬；阿拉伯史料稱唐軍四五萬人戰死、二萬至二萬五千人被俘。返回中亞的唐軍不足兩千人。大食方面的損失沒有可靠數字，多數說法只作「數萬」之辭。
dataEn: The strength figures differ wildly from source to source, so they can only be set down as each record has them. The Chinese side gives the Tang army as "three thousand Chinese and native troops", generally read as roughly ten thousand Chinese soldiers and twenty thousand Karluk mercenaries; the Arabic accounts put the combined Tang force at a hundred thousand, which is plainly inflated. For the Arab army, modern western estimates give something like thirty thousand men, while Chinese sources claim two hundred thousand including Tibetan contingents — wartime exaggeration of the classic kind. Tang records list a total of about twenty-four thousand men in the four Anxi garrisons, stationed at Kucha, Yanqi, Khotan and Shule, of which this expedition was only a part. In time, the battle falls in the eighth month of Tianbao 10, which is 133 of the Islamic calendar and converts to July or August of 751; the Chinese text says the army pushed more than seven hundred li in before reaching the city of Talas, which stood in the Talas river valley a short way from the Chu valley where Suyab lay. On losses: the Tongdian, the earliest narrative of the battle, gives thirty thousand dead; the Old Book of Tang gives twenty thousand; the Arabic sources say forty-five to fifty thousand Tang soldiers were killed and twenty to twenty-five thousand taken captive. Fewer than two thousand Tang men made it back to Chinese Central Asia. There is no reliable figure for Arab losses, and most accounts make do with a vague "tens of thousands".
cause: 本役不是偶發的遭遇，而是兩套秩序在絲路中段的一次攤牌。751年的唐朝正處在開元盛世的頂點，玄宗用兵於蔥嶺之外，安西都護府管著龜茲、焉耆、于闐、疏勒四鎮，高仙芝的方針是護商、通商、以兵衛路，把唐朝的實際控制推到帕米爾與大小勃律。阿拔斯則剛在750年的宰步勒之役推倒伍麥葉王朝，新王朝需要把河中的粟特城邦收編、清除唐與吐蕃的殘餘影響，並把突騎施與葛邏祿拉到自己一邊。直接導火索在中亞的城邦糾紛：石國（佉什）與大食交惡，其國子逃奔阿拉伯人求援；高仙芝先取石國，又用拔汗那兵掠朅支的村落，把兩支原本可以中立甚至友善的勢力都推向阿拉伯一方。於是原本因對付伍麥葉殘部而可能合作的兩方，在河中這條窄走廊上再無迴旋餘地：不是誰要滅誰，而是誰控制商路與城邦的稅源，誰就決定絲路的走向。
causeEn: This was not an accidental encounter but the settling of accounts between two systems of order in the middle of the Silk Road. In 751 the Tang Empire stood at the height of the Kaiyuan prosperity, the emperor fighting beyond the Congling range, the Protectorate General at Anxi holding the four garrisons of Kucha, Yanqi, Khotan and Shule, and Gao Xianzhi's policy being to guard the trade, keep the roads open and cover the caravans with soldiers, extending actual Tang control into the Pamirs and the Little and Great Bolü. The Abbasids, having only just overthrown the Umayyads at the Zab in 750, needed to bring the Sogdian cities of Transoxiana into line, to wipe out the remaining traces of Tang and Tibetan influence, and to draw the Turgesh and the Karluks onto their own side. The immediate spark lay in a quarrel among the Central Asian city-states: Shash fell out with the Arabs, and the prince of Shash fled to them for help; Gao Xianzhi took Shash first, and then used Farghana soldiers to raid the villages of the Qirghiz, pushing two peoples who might otherwise have stayed neutral, or even friendly, over to the Arab side. Two armies that might have co-operated against the last of the Umayyads were thus left, in that narrow corridor of Transoxiana, with no room to manoeuvre: not that either meant to destroy the other, but that whoever controlled the trade routes and the tax revenue of the cities would decide the shape of the Silk Road.
impact: 怛羅斯之役的直接後果，是唐朝在河中的影響力到此為止。大食軍佔領怛羅斯與周邊城邑，粟特諸邦在沒有唐軍保護的情況下逐步改宗，碎葉那座佛寺的香火隨之衰減，中亞的佛教重心往東退入河西走廊與唐境內。唐朝退守蔥嶺，四鎮仍在，影響力卻止步；755年安史之亂爆發，安西兵被抽調入關，河中最後的機會也隨之關門。另一條影響線是技術與物種的流動：阿拉伯方面的記述稱，被俘的唐人中有造紙工匠，把造紙術帶到撒馬爾罕，此後紙張成本下降，知識記錄的方式為之一變；粟特城市在八世紀末已有紙坊，巴格達更在794年前後設有造紙工坊。至於「怛羅斯之役發明了火藥」一說，屬於後世流傳的說法：現存最早寫得出火藥配方的文字，是唐末九世紀的煉丹文獻《真元妙道要略》，本役本身沒有任何火藥武器的可靠記載。值得注意的是關係並未長期敵對：752年12月，阿拔斯遣使抵長安，753年又有數次往來，石國重新稱臣，雙方回到以使節與商旅為主的務實狀態。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of Talas was the end of Tang influence in Transoxiana. The Arab army occupied Talas and the towns around it, the Sogdian states gradually changed faith now that no Tang army stood over them, the incense of the great temple at Suyab thinned out, and the centre of Central Asian Buddhism shifted east into the Hexi corridor and into Tang territory. The Tang pulled back to the Congling range; the four garrisons remained but their reach stopped there, and when the An Lushan rebellion broke out in 755 and Anxi troops were pulled back into the passes, the last opening in Transoxiana was shut for good. A second line of impact ran through the movement of techniques and materials: Arabic accounts say that among the Tang prisoners were papermakers who carried the craft to Samarkand, after which the cost of paper fell and the way knowledge was recorded changed for good; paper workshops existed in Sogdian cities by the end of the eighth century, and Baghdad had one by about 794. The claim that gunpowder was invented at Talas belongs to later legend: the earliest surviving text that actually sets out a gunpowder formula is the ninth-century Tang alchemical treatise Zhenyuan miaodao yaolue, and this battle has no reliable record of any gunpowder weapon. It is worth noting that the two sides did not remain enemies for long: an Abbasid envoy reached Chang'an in December 752, there were further exchanges in 753, Shash returned to Tang vassalage, and the relationship settled back into a practical one carried by envoys and merchants.
result: 打到第五日，唐軍主力崩潰：大食正面進逼，葛邏祿倒戈抄背，兩面受敵的唐軍在入夜前退入營寨，翌日東撤時又在翻越天山的途中遭拔汗那舊部偷襲，隊伍被切斷。高仙芝與封常清、李嗣業等少數將官得以脫身，率不足兩千人的隊伍退回安西；部眾、馬匹、攻城器械與輜重大多淪為敵有，數萬俘虜被帶往撒馬爾罕與呼羅珊。那尊供在怛羅斯佛寺的十一尺金佛最終由唐軍自己毀掉——據唐人記載，李嗣業以杵搗之，血流及地——因為它已成了對方用來惑眾的旗幟。這一場勝負在河中定了調：大食守住了通往布哈拉與撒馬爾罕的商路，突騎施與葛邏祿各自分離，龜茲與疏勒以外的中亞不再有唐兵，只有唐的使節與商人。對唐來說，751年是西征的終點；對大食來說，它只是新王朝在東方邊界的一次立威，而真正決定東亞與中亞格局的變化，三年後在安史之亂裡到來。
resultEn: By the fifth day the Tang main force had come apart: the Arabs pressed in from the front, the Karluks turned and struck the rear, and the two-sided Tang army broke into its camp before nightfall, then was cut apart on the following morning while withdrawing east across the Tian Shan by the Ferghana allies who had turned on them. Gao Xianzhi, with Feng Changqing, Li Siye and a handful of other officers, got away and led fewer than two thousand men back towards Anxi; the men, the horses, the siege equipment and the baggage were largely lost to the enemy, and tens of thousands of captives were carried off to Samarkand and Khurasan. The eleven-foot gilt Buddha that the Tang had set up in the temple at Talas was finally destroyed by the Tang themselves — the records have Li Siye beating it down with a rammer until the blood ran across the ground — because by then it had become a banner the enemy could rally men around. The result settled the tone of Transoxiana: the Arabs held the trade road to Bukhara and Samarkand, the Turgesh and the Karluks each went their own way, and beyond Kucha and Shule Central Asia had no more Tang soldiers in it, only Tang envoys and Tang merchants. For the Tang, 751 was the end of the western campaigns; for the Arabs it was only a young dynasty's display of force on its eastern frontier, and the change that really decided the shape of East and Central Asia arrived three years later, with the An Lushan rebellion.
